thread:
maya: Heads-up — planning a midnight maintenance for saturn-pool (rolling reboots + NIC driver patch). target start 00:30 UTC, ~2h window. will do staggered cohorts and cache preheat.

jon: thumbs, which cohorts? can we avoid AZ3 during their batch jobs?

maya: splitting into 20-node cohorts, start AZ1 -> AZ2 -> AZ3, pause 10m between cohorts to observe. no changes to scheduler config.

kevin: cost note — if we spill to burst pools we'll use spot capacity; that increases preempt risk. do we want to reserve a small dedicated backstop?

maya: yes — plan is to route critical tenant traffic to the dedicated reserve (pool-reserve-1) for the window. noncritical tasks go to spot.

jon: for KV cache: we should seed the kvcache after nodes come back. otherwise cold-start will crush latency. recommend preheat from prefix samples.

maya: agreed. schedule: after each cohort reboot completes, run `infra-tool kvcache:seed --pool saturn --parallel 4 --sample-file s3://infra/preheat/saturn-prefixes.json`

ops-bot: Maintenance created: MNT-2026-045 by maya. ETA 2026-05-12T00:30:00Z. Affected: saturn-pool (GPU).

sre-lead: Add a smoke check: `curl -sS https://canary.internal/health | jq .tokens_per_sec` should be within 10% of baseline before proceeding to next cohort. If >20% drop, rollback cohort and notify pager.

kevin: networking check — NIC driver patch may change MTU handling. ops, please run `netdiag` on a canary node prepatch and postpatch.

jon: also verify egress routes for pool-reserve-1. last time a stale route caused ~15min of elevated latency.

maya: noted. ops, can you run a quick route-table diff and share?

kevin: I'll own route diff and netdiag. will post commands+results in thread 15m before start.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled 15m before: MNT-2026-045 starts in 15 minutes.

jon: runbook checklist (compact):
- mark cohort nodes `cordon`
- migrate running tenants with `dispatch redistribute --policy graceful --timeout 5m`
- drain node `infra-drain start NODE`
- reboot and apply NIC patch
- run netdiag + kvcache seed
- run canary smoke checks
- uncordon

maya: Small ask: tag tenants with `critical=true` so dispatch honors reserve routing. ops, we need an updated tenant map in case manual reroute required.

ops-bot: tenant-map snapshot taken: s3://infra/snapshots/tenant-map-6790123456.json

kevin: quick heads up — cross-region fallback is enabled but we shouldn't trigger it unless >30% cohort failure. fallback would increase egress costs.

jon: noted — will monitor. any objections to proceeding as planned?

sre-lead: no objections. ensure status page copy includes expected impact: "short-lived cache coldness for noncritical traffic; critical routes maintained via reserved pool"

maya: perfect. I'll post to #status and the customer-facing status page 10m before start. :thumbsup:

kevin: posting netdiag output now (PM will attach logs).

ops-bot: MNT-2026-045: cohort AZ1 completed, kvcache seed run (3/3 shards), smoke within 5% baseline. Proceeding to AZ2.

jon: AZ2 cordon started. redispatch in progress.

sre-lead: watch for elevated 429s on /v1/generate endpoint — if observed >0.5% over 5m, pause.

ops-bot: MNT-2026-045: AZ2 completed, netdiag no regressions, kvcache seeded, smoke OK. Proceeding to AZ3.

kevin: AZ3 cordon halfway through; spotted one node failing post-patch reboot to come back with NIC link flaps. isolating it and moving tenants off before rebooting a second time.

maya: good catch. hold the cohort until node health stabilized. ops, what's ETA on reimage?

ops-bot: Node node-az3-199 marked for reimage. ETA 12m.

jon: rerouted remaining pods off that node to pool-reserve-1. no customer-facing errors so far.

sre-lead: once node stable, finish patch, run kvcache seed for that node's shards and then final smoke.

ops-bot: MNT-2026-045 completed: all cohorts finished, final smoke within baseline, no cross-region fallback. Total maintenance time 1h45m.

maya: thanks team. I'll update the incident/maintenance ticket and close the loop with PGs. notes: consider pre-seeding a larger prefix set next run to shave warmup spikes.

kevin: cost takeaway — using pool-reserve-1 avoided spilling into expensive cross-region burst; estimate cost delta +$420 for the window vs full spot fallback.

jon: added action item: schedule preheat run 1h before next maintenance to reduce tail latency.

maya: added to backlog. good job everyone. :raised_hands:
